content.worksheet_title: VOCABULARY, LITERACY & SCENARIO — The Toolbelt at Berth 4
content.guia_header: IMARPOR-CC · Guía 1 · The Maritime Operations Pro · Nivel A1.2 · Sesión 2 (parte 3)

bilingual_instruction_block.main_message_en: You read the Operational Report. You wrote your first shift mini-report. Now you OWN the 25 words. In this session you spell them, see them, say them, sort them, and use them. Andrea opens her Port Glossary — you open yours.
bilingual_instruction_block.main_message_es: Leíste el Reporte Operativo. Escribiste tu primer mini-reporte de turno. Ahora HACES TUYAS las 25 palabras. En esta sesión las deletreas, las ves, las dices, las clasificas y las usas. Andrea abre su Port Glossary — tú abres el tuyo.
bilingual_instruction_block.scenario_caption_en: Setting: dock office, Berth 4, Port of Buenaventura · 06:00 · Captain Restrepo runs a quick vocabulary check before the BUENAVENTURA EXPRESS docks at 07:30.
bilingual_instruction_block.scenario_caption_es: Escenario: oficina del muelle, Berth 4, Puerto de Buenaventura · 06:00 · Capitán Restrepo hace un quick check de vocabulario antes del atraque del BUENAVENTURA EXPRESS a las 07:30.

the_toolbelt.policy_note: GAP_2 OVERRIDE per pm-1-2 _known_gaps · 5 categorías × 5 términos = 25 términos (NO 20 strict canónico). Cada término incluye pronunciation_for_spanish + stress + categoría + ejemplo del Master Anchor o del borrador PM-2.4.

terms.definition_en: the place at the dock where a ship stops
terms.definition_es: el lugar del muelle donde un buque atraca
terms.pronunciation_for_spanish: berz (la 'th' como una 'z' suave de 'caza' española)
terms.stress: 1-syllable · primary stress on the only syllable [BERTH]
terms.example_from_anchor: The BUENAVENTURA EXPRESS is at Berth 4.

terms.definition_en: the front part of a ship
terms.definition_es: la parte delantera del buque
terms.pronunciation_for_spanish: báu (rima con 'how' en inglés · NO con 'arco' bow de flecha)
terms.example_from_anchor: The bow is forward; the stern is aft.

terms.definition_en: the back part of a ship
terms.definition_es: la parte trasera del buque
terms.pronunciation_for_spanish: stern (con 'r' suave inglesa, no la 'r' fuerte española)
terms.example_from_anchor: The stern is aft of the bridge.

terms.definition_en: the left side of a ship looking forward
terms.definition_es: el costado izquierdo del buque mirando hacia proa
terms.example_from_anchor: The port-side is alongside the dock.

terms.definition_en: the right side of a ship looking forward
terms.definition_es: el costado derecho del buque mirando hacia proa
terms.pronunciation_for_spanish: stár-bord (la 'a' larga, la segunda sílaba muy débil)
terms.example_from_anchor: The starboard side faces the open water.

terms.definition_en: wait and listen on the radio channel
terms.definition_es: esperar y escuchar en el canal de radio
terms.example_from_anchor: Pilot: 'Stand by on Channel 16.'

terms.definition_en: I have received your message
terms.definition_es: recibí tu mensaje
terms.example_from_anchor: Captain Lopera: 'Roger. Berth 4 confirmed.'

terms.definition_en: please repeat your last message
terms.definition_es: por favor repite tu último mensaje
terms.example_from_anchor: Andrea: 'Say again, please. Channel was noisy.'

terms.definition_en: I finished my message; your turn to speak
terms.definition_es: terminé mi mensaje; tu turno de hablar
terms.example_from_anchor: Pilot: 'BUENAVENTURA EXPRESS, ETA 07:30. Over.'

terms.definition_en: this conversation is finished
terms.definition_es: esta conversación terminó
terms.example_from_anchor: Captain Lopera: 'Confirmed. Out.'

terms.definition_en: to bring a ship alongside the berth
terms.definition_es: atracar un buque al costado del muelle
terms.example_from_anchor: The vessel docks at 07:30.

terms.definition_en: the goods carried on a ship
terms.definition_es: la mercancía que transporta el buque
terms.example_from_anchor: Cargo is in the hold.

terms.definition_en: a metal box used to ship cargo
terms.definition_es: una caja metálica para transportar mercancía
terms.example_from_anchor: 20 containers are on deck.

terms.definition_en: the machine that lifts containers
terms.definition_es: la máquina que levanta contenedores
terms.example_from_anchor: Crane 2 is ready at Berth 4.

terms.definition_en: to tie a ship with ropes to the dock
terms.definition_es: amarrar un buque con cabos al muelle
terms.example_from_anchor: The crew moors the vessel port-side.

terms.definition_en: to give information about a situation
terms.definition_es: informar sobre una situación
terms.example_from_anchor: Andrea reports cargo status to Captain Restrepo.

terms.definition_en: to look at something to confirm it is correct
terms.definition_es: revisar algo para confirmar que está correcto
terms.example_from_anchor: I check the manifest before the crane lifts.

terms.definition_en: to watch and direct an operation
terms.definition_es: vigilar y dirigir una operación
terms.example_from_anchor: Captain Restrepo supervises the morning shift.

terms.definition_en: to organize people or actions to work together
terms.definition_es: organizar personas o acciones para trabajar juntas
terms.example_from_anchor: Andrea coordinates the docking with the pilot.

terms.definition_en: to say that something is true or agreed
terms.definition_es: decir que algo es verdadero o acordado
terms.example_from_anchor: Captain Lopera confirms ETA on the radio.

terms.definition_en: a period of work hours
terms.definition_es: un periodo de horas laborales
terms.example_from_anchor: Andrea is on the morning shift.

terms.definition_en: Estimated Time of Arrival
terms.definition_es: tiempo estimado de llegada
terms.example_from_anchor: ETA: 07:30 at Berth 4.

terms.definition_en: next to and parallel with the dock
terms.definition_es: al costado y paralelo al muelle
terms.example_from_anchor: The vessel is alongside Berth 4.

terms.definition_en: prepared and able to act
terms.definition_es: preparado y capaz de actuar
terms.example_from_anchor: Crane 2 is ready. Crew is ready.

terms.definition_en: a ship (formal/operational term)
terms.definition_es: un buque (término formal/operacional)
terms.example_from_anchor: The vessel BUENAVENTURA EXPRESS arrives at 07:30.

archetype_A_phonics_and_spelling.actua_como: Phonics Specialist & ESP Pronunciation Coach. Creates phonics activities adapted for maritime-port technical vocabulary at A1.2.

warm_up_consolidacion.title: Mirror Talking — 'th' vs 's' minimal pairs
warm_up_consolidacion.description_en: Take a small mirror. Watch your tongue when you say 'berth' and 'bus'. The 'th' shows tongue between teeth. The 's' keeps tongue behind teeth.
warm_up_consolidacion.description_es: Toma un espejo pequeño. Observa tu lengua cuando dices 'berth' y 'bus'. La 'th' muestra la lengua entre los dientes. La 's' mantiene la lengua detrás de los dientes.

main_activity.title: Sound Sorting — Stress Pattern Buckets
main_activity.description_en: Sort the 25 Toolbelt terms into 4 buckets by stress pattern: [1-syllable], [2-syllable stress on 1st], [2-syllable stress on 2nd], [3+ syllables].
main_activity.description_es: Clasifica los 25 términos del Toolbelt en 4 cubetas según patrón de acento: [1 sílaba], [2 sílabas acento 1ra], [2 sílabas acento 2da], [3+ sílabas].

language_bank: Where is the stress in 'container'? — On TAIN.
The 'th' in 'berth' is between the teeth.
archetype_A_phonics_and_spelling.micro_capsula: > 🎧 **Audio Cue:** En 'container' el acento NO está al inicio · es kon-TÉI-ner. Decirlo mal en radio VHF cuesta 5 segundos de '*say again*'.

archetype_B_vocabulary_development.actua_como: Vocabulary Development Specialist & ESP Lexical Architect. Builds deep maritime vocabulary through semantic relationships, not memorization.

warm_up_consolidacion.title: Word Wall — 5 Categorías Vivas
warm_up_consolidacion.description_en: On 5 wall posters (one per Toolbelt category), Andrea pins the 25 cards. The wall stays visible the whole shift.
warm_up_consolidacion.description_es: En 5 carteles de pared (uno por categoría del Toolbelt), Andrea fija las 25 tarjetas. El muro queda visible todo el turno.

main_activity.title: Semantic Map — 'BERTH' as central node
main_activity.description_en: In the Port Glossary notebook, draw 'berth' at the center. Connect 4 nodes: WHERE (alongside, dock, port-side), WHAT (vessel, cargo, container), WHO (Andrea, Captain Lopera, crane operator), ACTION (dock, moor, supervise).
main_activity.description_es: En el cuaderno Port Glossary, dibuja 'berth' en el centro. Conecta 4 nodos: DÓNDE (alongside, dock, port-side), QUÉ (vessel, cargo, container), QUIÉN (Andrea, Captain Lopera, operario de grúa), ACCIÓN (dock, moor, supervise).

language_bank: Berth is a place. Dock is a place AND an action.
Vessel is more formal than ship.
A container is one cargo unit. Cargo is the whole load.
archetype_B_vocabulary_development.micro_capsula: > 📌 **Lexical Rule:** 'dock' = sustantivo (lugar) Y verbo (atracar). El contexto dice cuál es. *El barco atraca en el muelle* → The vessel docks at the dock.

archetype_C_reading_fluency.actua_como: Reading Fluency Coach & ESP Prosody Specialist. Transforms slow word-by-word readers into smooth, expressive maritime communicators.

warm_up_consolidacion.title: Repeated Reading — Operational Report aloud × 3
warm_up_consolidacion.description_en: Read the PM-2.3 Operational Report aloud three times: (1) for accuracy, (2) for stress on Toolbelt terms, (3) for radio-protocol pace.
warm_up_consolidacion.description_es: Lee el Reporte Operativo de PM-2.3 en voz alta tres veces: (1) por precisión, (2) por acento en términos Toolbelt, (3) al ritmo de protocolo de radio.

main_activity.title: Cloze — Captain Lopera's Radio Brief
main_activity.description_en: Fill the gaps with Toolbelt 25 terms. Mini-text adapted from Master Anchor (10 gaps).
main_activity.description_es: Completa los huecos con términos del Toolbelt 25. Mini-texto adaptado del Master Anchor (10 huecos).
main_activity.cloze_text_en: Captain Lopera to dock office: ETA 07:30. The ______ (1) BUENAVENTURA EXPRESS is ______ (2) Berth 4. ______ (3)-side is alongside. The crew ______ (4) the vessel. ______ (5) 2 is ready. We have 20 ______ (6) on deck. Andrea ______ (7) cargo status. Captain Restrepo ______ (8) the shift. ______ (9). Out.

language_bank: Read with the rhythm of the radio: short bursts, clear stress.
archetype_C_reading_fluency.micro_capsula: > 🎙️ **Radio Pacing:** Lee el reporte como si lo dijeras por VHF · 1 idea = 1 respiración. Si pierdes el aire, perdiste a Captain Lopera.

archetype_D_writing_scaffolding.actua_como: Writing Scaffold Designer & ESP Literacy Bridge Specialist. Builds the bridge from oral maritime language to written operational reports.

warm_up_consolidacion.title: LEA — Andrea narrates her first hour
warm_up_consolidacion.description_en: Listen to Andrea narrate her first hour at Berth 4 (audio 90s). Transcribe 5 sentences. Underline every Toolbelt term you hear.
warm_up_consolidacion.description_es: Escucha a Andrea narrar su primera hora en Berth 4 (audio 90s). Transcribe 5 oraciones. Subraya cada término del Toolbelt que escuches.

main_activity.title: Guided Writing — Your Port Glossary entry
main_activity.description_en: Pick 5 terms (one per category). For each, write a Port Glossary entry: [TERM] · [pronunciation in your own ear] · [1 sentence from your shift].
main_activity.description_es: Elige 5 términos (uno por categoría). Para cada uno, escribe una entrada del Port Glossary: [TÉRMINO] · [pronunciación a tu propio oído] · [1 oración de tu turno].
main_activity.model_entry_en: BERTH · 'berz' · Andrea is at Berth 4 at 06:00.
main_activity.model_entry_es: BERTH · 'berz' · Andrea está en Berth 4 a las 06:00.

language_bank: I am at the berth. — Yo estoy en el atracadero.
The vessel is alongside. — El buque está al costado.
I check the cargo. — Yo reviso la mercancía.
archetype_D_writing_scaffolding.micro_capsula: > ✍️ **Scaffold Rule:** Tu Port Glossary NO se borra · NO se corrige con tinta roja. El docente responde con un *Dialogue Journal* mostrando la forma correcta SIN tachar la tuya.

archetype_E_interactive_literacy.actua_como: Interactive Literacy Architect & ESP Collaborative Reading Specialist. Designs activities where the Operational Report becomes a tool for crew communication.

warm_up_consolidacion.title: Read-Pair-Share — 5 Toolbelt cards
warm_up_consolidacion.description_en: Read 5 random Toolbelt cards alone (3 min). Compare with your pair (3 min). Share the hardest term with the class (4 min).
warm_up_consolidacion.description_es: Lee 5 tarjetas Toolbelt al azar solo (3 min). Compara con tu pareja (3 min). Comparte el término más difícil con la clase (4 min).

main_activity.title: Jigsaw Reading — 5 Expert Groups, 1 Operation
main_activity.description_en: 5 Expert Groups (one per Toolbelt category) study their 5 terms deeply. Then re-form Home Groups (1 expert per category × 5) and teach each other. Final: each Home Group writes a 5-sentence operational micro-report using ALL 25 terms.
main_activity.description_es: 5 Expert Groups (uno por categoría Toolbelt) estudian sus 5 términos a fondo. Luego se reagrupan en Home Groups (1 experto por categoría × 5) y se enseñan entre sí. Final: cada Home Group escribe un micro-reporte operativo de 5 oraciones usando los 25 términos.
main_activity.home_group_output: Micro-reporte operativo · 5 oraciones · usa 25 términos (5 por miembro Home Group)

language_bank: I am the expert on radio terms. Let me explain 'roger' and 'over'.
archetype_E_interactive_literacy.micro_capsula: > 🤝 **Jigsaw Rule:** Si tu Home Group pierde un experto, pierde 5 términos. La operación de atraque NO se completa con vocabulario faltante. Aprender es responsabilidad colectiva.
